description: Authoritative inventory of durable Aperture test suites and verification gates

suites.name: GitHub Release Update Workflow
suites.description: Exercises the real GitHub update entry point with fixture HTTP responses: full ZIP deployment, digest rejection, retained session, and up-to-date no-op.

suites.name: Release Update and Data Retention
suites.description: Exercises the production installer, profile snapshots and retention, real locked-file rollback, package tampering and protected paths.

suites.name: Workspace Cleanup Behavior
suites.description: Executes cleanup against an isolated workspace fixture and verifies dry-run behavior, exact artifact removal, unchanged profiles/backups/source/reports and repeatability.

suites.name: Workflow Mutation Verification
suites.description: Builds isolated source copies with reversed duration ordering and lost saved resume positions. Requires the corresponding behavioral assertion to fail; compilation errors and unrelated failures do not count.

suites.name: Seeded Library and Portable Profile Workflows
suites.description: Seeded Unicode libraries, independent ordering oracle, cache edits, real WAV imports, duplicate imports, actual save/load, resume positions, playlist deletion, preferences, bookmarks and portable relocation. Fixed regression seeds plus a logged random seed; replay with -Seed.

suites.name: Real App Playback and Restart Workflows
suites.description: Runs an isolated real executable with generated PCM media through public IPC: decode, pause stability, advancing playback clock, seek accuracy, queue next/previous, stop, three restart cycles, on-disk resume verification and command latency. Refuses to touch an existing app session.

suites.name: Unit Tests
suites.description: Comprehensive unit test suite for media library, subtitles, audio, video adjustments, playback session, accessibility, and UI components.

suites.name: Parser & Media Corpus Tests
suites.description: Deterministic manifest-driven corpus test suite exercising observable accept/reject behavior, malformed/truncated boundaries, Unicode, and extension disagreement for JSON, playlists, subtitles, URLs, command-line/IPC, settings, and media containers.

suites.name: Rendering Integration Tests
suites.description: Direct2D DC render target and DirectWrite color font text layout rendering integration tests.

suites.name: Real UI Crash Smoke Test
suites.description: End-to-end native-window smoke test that opens the supplied video through Aperture's real launch path, opens and dismisses the native file picker, exercises hover, scrolling, Settings, right-click, and library removal, and records process liveness plus matching WER crash evidence after each action.

suites.name: Persistence Tests
suites.description: Persistence, JSON serialization limits, schema migration, cache budget, rotating backups, and portable path relocation tests.

suites.name: IPC Tests
suites.description: Single-instance named pipe IPC envelope serialization, framing, and command dispatch tests.

suites.name: DLL Loader Tests
suites.description: Dynamic DLL loading isolation and runtime dependency resolution tests for libmpv.

suites.name: Diagnostics Tests
suites.description: Root-local logging, diagnostic bundle generation, non-destructive live hang dump capture, and unhandled exception crash dump verification.

suites.name: Self-Updater Deterministic Tests
suites.description: Deterministic self-updater verification: canonical manifest validation, ECDSA P-256 detached signatures, SHA-256 hashes, Authenticode thumbprint pinning, PE x64 architecture, bounds, atomic swap and rollback, same-user helper verification, and temp cleanup.

suites.name: Release Channel Policy & Schema Validation
suites.description: Validation of authoritative release channel policy (channels.json), schema integrity, prerelease rules, and promotion constraints.

suites.name: Dependency Inventory & Integrity Check
suites.description: Validation of authoritative dependency inventory, toolchain versions, and SHA-256 hashes for all vendored runtime, header, and font artifacts.

suites.name: Runtime-Only Release Layout Tests
suites.description: Verifies that published runtime folders accept only Aperture.exe, libmpv, required private fonts, and locale catalogs, while rejecting manifests, symbols, writable state, missing assets, and modified dependencies.

suites.name: Threat Boundary & Security Invariant Validation
suites.description: Validation of authoritative threat boundary reference, machine-readable manifest, C++ symbol references, test coverage mappings, and portable storage invariants.

suites.name: PE Dependencies & Static Runtime Tests
suites.description: Pure-Python PE parser validation, strict x64 machine architecture enforcement, and static C/C++ runtime linkage check.

suites.name: Package Distribution Verification
suites.description: Package integrity verification, SHA-256 validation, PE import evidence, isolated temporary staging startup, and exact-PID lifecycle verification.

suites.name: Authenticode Signing & Verification Tests
suites.description: Authenticode code-signing, signtool discovery, certificate validation, EKU/expiry verification, SHA-256 digest/timestamp enforcement, dry-run mode, and unsigned package reporting tests.

suites.name: Release Symbol Archive & PE/PDB Metadata Tests
suites.description: Deterministic symbol archive creation, verification, PE CodeView RSDS extraction, PDB MSF 7.0 stream inspection, content-address naming enforcement, and tamper detection.

suites.name: Subtitle Parser Fuzz Harness
suites.description: Subtitle parser fuzzing with random and mutated subtitle inputs.

suites.name: JSON Mutation Fuzz Harness
suites.description: JsonValue parser and serializer mutation fuzz harness.

suites.name: Profile Deterministic Fuzz Harness
suites.description: Deterministic fuzz testing of user settings and media profile mutations.

suites.name: Application Verifier Hardening Gate
suites.description: Runtime heap, handle, lock, and memory verification using Microsoft Application Verifier.

suites.name: Deterministic Release Build Reproducibility Gate
suites.description: Two clean isolated Release builds from identical sources/toolchain produce equivalent normalized binaries with structural PE verification, compiler/SDK metadata reporting, and guaranteed temporary cleanup.

suites.name: MSVC C++17 Native Static Code Analysis Gate
suites.description: Deterministic MSVC C++17 native static code analysis (/analyze) using authoritative CMake source/build configuration with external temporary directory isolation and guaranteed artifact cleanup.

suites.name: Startup & Resource Benchmark Gate
suites.description: Deterministic startup latency and memory resource benchmark gate with explicit regression budgets, isolated temporary staging, and guaranteed cleanup.

suites.name: Visual Regression Gate
suites.description: Deterministic real-window visual regression capture and pixel comparison on Windows with fixed scenes, explicit tolerances, external diagnostics, and guaranteed temporary cleanup.

suites.name: Async Shutdown Stress Suite
suites.description: Deterministic async shutdown stress harness exercising concurrent media/folder work, player event callbacks, HTTP updater/subtitle bounded fakes, diagnostics watchdog, and UI callback dispatch under seeded schedules with lifetime/leak invariant verification.

suites.name: Thumbnail Cache Workflows
suites.description: Production image codec, legacy background migration, corruption recovery, protected library cache, active budgets, concurrent writers, and large-cache accounting.

suites.name: libmpv Playback Compatibility
suites.artifactPolicy: root_local_scratch: scratch/libmpv-tests; retain logs until inspection, then remove generated artifacts
suites.description: Absolute-path/hash-checked x64 engine playback: codec/container matrix, D3D11 hardware and software decoding, HDR10, ASS/SRT/mov_text, controls, audio filters, PNG screenshots, SW render preview and loopback HTTP.
